trademark rights.

`nvidia-geforce-rtx.tres` shows the badge of the NVIDIA file without its
surrounding page (region 290, 278, 2420 × 730); the pixels and proportions are
not changed.

NVIDIA, the NVIDIA logo, GeForce RTX and DLSS are trademarks and/or registered
trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation in the U.S. and other countries. AMD, the AMD
Arrow logo, AMD FSR and combinations thereof are trademarks of Advanced Micro
Devices, Inc.

The NVIDIA marks are shown on the splash screen and in the credits only in
builds that include NVIDIA DLSS, with NVIDIA's approval.
